newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMBI cut to sell from buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMBI cut to sell from buy.

text.p: -- Madison Securities analyst William Plovanic said he cut AMBI Inc to sell from buy.
-- Shares in the food products company were up 7/16 to 2-3/8 on thin volume.

-- Plovanic said sales projections for AMBI's Cardia Salt Alternative product continue to fall; a new strategy of growth through acquisitions has yet to be proven; the divestiture of a food ingredients business removed profitable segments of the company; and new technologies could take years to develop.
